📐 Volume Flip 5 Pattern Rules
  • 1
    5-Candle Sequence on 5-Minute Timeframe:
    Pattern forms across exactly 5 consecutive volume bars (25-minute formation window).
  • 2
    Color Symmetry:
    🟢 Bullish Base: Candle 1 (Red) • Candle 2 (Red) • Candle 3 (Green - Flip) • Candle 4 (Red) • Candle 5 (Red)
    🔴 Bearish Base: Candle 1 (Green) • Candle 2 (Green) • Candle 3 (Red - Flip) • Candle 4 (Green) • Candle 5 (Green)
  • 3
    Candle 3 Volume Pocket (Crucial Zero-Noise Filter):
    As taught by SS Volume Trader in the reference chart, Candle 3 is the contraction pocket: Volume(C3) < Volume(C2) and Volume(C3) < Volume(C4).
  • 4
    Dominant Surrounding Volume:
    Surrounding bars must exhibit high institutional volume: Max(C1, C2, C4, C5) ≥ 1.25x SMA20 and bar turnover ≥ ₹15 Lakhs. Eliminates illiquid noise.
  • 5
    Reference High & Low Levels:
    Resistance = High of Candle 3. Support = Low of Candle 3.
  • 6
    Execution & Risk Parameters:
    Breakout beyond C3 High → Long. Breakdown below C3 Low → Short. Target: 2.0R. Trailed Stop Loss to Breakeven at 1.0R favorable excursion. EOD square-off at 15:15.
